name: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Warm Peach-Plum Compote, Almond Butter & Honey

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and quarter peaches and plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into thin wedges and place in a medium saucepan along with vanilla and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 peaches
2 plums
½ tsp vanilla extract
⅛ tsp cardamom, ground
⅛ tsp nutmeg, ground
1 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Set the pan over medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until fruit is tender and saucy, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
To serve, divide yogurt, almond butter, and peach-plum compote between bowls, then drizzle with honey. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup natural almond butter
2 tsp honey
